hard_boundaries: P6 is synthesis/evaluation design, not a new universal scalar or fifth contribution.
A15a / AgentWatcher-natural / corrected P2b remain historical original-26 subset studies.
P2b has 390 generations but 78 model×decision cells; five repeats are stability repeats, not independent samples.
Selected-population masking analyses are post-hoc and composition-confounded; do not call them causal effects.
AttriGuard fuzzy-survival routes are not final false positives.
R2A benign threshold robustness does not establish retained attack sensitivity at alternative thresholds.
P0b-3 is SAME_EXTERNAL_REGIME with population/suite qualification, not an exact published reproduction.
